question: Nothing else re-renders this component. You click the button 3 times. What does it show?
say: Nothing else re-renders this component. You click the button three times. What does it show?
explanation: The ref does go up to 3, but changing ref.current never triggers a re-render, so the button keeps showing 0.
explainSay: Zero clicks. The ref changes, but changing a ref never re-renders, so the screen stays the same.
